lines.zh: 毛毛虫一节节挪上叶面
lines.en: The caterpillar inches up the leaf.

lines.zh: 它的身体拱起来又摊平
lines.en: Its body humps and flattens.
Its hooks grip a vein.
It reaches its front half out.

lines.zh: 身体跟着一点点收上来
lines.en: The rest draws up after it.

lines.zh: 它绕开叶片上的一道裂缝
lines.en: It detours around a split in the leaf.
It reaches the edge and stops.
Then it turns to the next leaf.
It crosses a vein along the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 它经过一只小虫，没有理
lines.en: It passes a small insect and ignores it.

lines.zh: 它慢慢爬到乳草的茎上
lines.en: It works its way onto a milkweed stem.
It keeps its body pressed close.
The caterpillar rests at the leaf's centre.
It chews the leaf flesh slowly.
Its head hangs raised, as if listening.
Sun comes through the leaf onto it.
Its segments pulse gently.
It grooms its head with its feet.
It straightens out a little.
A fleck of leaf lands on its back.
It pays it no mind at all.
It goes on eating the leaf.

lines.zh: 它的足慢慢换了个位置
lines.en: Its feet find new positions.
It curls into a bend.
Then stretches out again.
It swells and settles barely at all.
It props its front half higher.
As if looking further off.
It slowly turns on its side.
Its feet grip the leaf firmly.
The caterpillar raises its head at you.
Its front half rears up.
It tilts its head and does not leave.
Its feet grip the leaf harder.
It shows no fear of you.
It creeps slowly toward your hand.
It climbs onto your knuckle.
It turns a corner on your hand.
It takes your finger for a stem.
It starts climbing up.
It stops at the base of your finger.
Then it turns back.
The caterpillar curls into a ball.
Its feet kick out at random.
It slips half an inch down the leaf.
It draws itself into a knot.
A fleck of leaf sticks to it.
It eases open and crawls again.
It crawls slower than before.
It hides in a hollow along the vein.
It stays curled a long while.
It still crawls toward the leaf.
The caterpillar crawls toward a leaf.
It buries its head at the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 它咬出一个弧形的缺口
lines.en: Its bite carves an arc.
It chews fast, segments jumping.

lines.zh: 它爬到叶子更软的一边
lines.en: It crawls to the softer side of the leaf.
Done, it lifts its head for a new leaf.

lines.zh: 它对你递的叶子也肯吃
lines.en: It will take a leaf you offer.
It jams its mouthparts between the veins.
It leaves half a leaf.
It rests a moment on the leaf.
The caterpillar curls at the bump.
It clings hard to the leaf.
The shove carries it a short way.
Its body curls into a hook.
It hooks onto your knuckle.
The knock slides it off the leaf.
It lands on another leaf.
It loosens segment by segment.
It finds a vein again.
Then it goes back to the leaf.

lines.zh: 两条幼虫挤在一片叶上
lines.en: Two larvae crowd onto one leaf.
Their heads almost touch.
Each works its own half.
They drift together and apart.

lines.zh: 一条从另一条身上爬过
lines.en: One crawls over the other.
Their body ripples keep time.
The leaf is eaten to a skeleton.
They move to a fresh leaf together.
They rest side by side.
One leaf cannot feed two mouths.
The caterpillar clamps the leaf edge.
It drags itself over to eat.
Several of its feet clamp the stem.
It hauls the bitten piece near.

lines.zh: 它凑近你递来的东西闻
lines.en: It leans in to sniff what you offer.
It refuses and turns to leaves.
It buries itself in the leaf.
It eats a hole through.
It pokes its head through.
It crawls to the next leaf.
The caterpillar lifts its head toward you.
Its front half rears.
It takes you for the leaf's edge.
It crawls up toward your fingers.
Its segments tighten.
It stops, as if hesitating.
It tests a bite on your finger.
It finds no vein in your palm.
It slowly starts to crawl again.
It reaches your wrist.

lines.zh: 毛毛虫在你手上转来转去
lines.en: The caterpillar wanders over your hand.
It finds no edge to eat.
It reaches its body out to test.
It bites once and draws back.
It passes between your fingers.
It rears its head up high.
It settles on your skin, still.
Its feet inch over, one by one.
It starts gnawing the cloth of your cuff.
It has taken cloth for a leaf.
The caterpillar nips you.
It humps up and bumps you.
Its small feet scrape across your wrist.
It clamps the skin and will not let go.
It gives a tug with hardly any force.
It smears leaf crumbs over your hand.
It strains to haul itself across.
It drops off the leaf and rolls up tight.
It twists back onto its belly.
It goes back to gnawing your finger.
Something moves on the leaf's underside.
The caterpillar creeps out along a vein.

lines.zh: 它刚啃过的地方还是湿的
lines.en: Where it has eaten, the leaf is still wet.
It reaches across from the last leaf.
It stops and takes a bite.

lines.zh: 一片叶屑从它身上落下
lines.en: A fleck of leaf falls from it.
It hauls its whole body across.
It coils into a ring at the leaf's heart.
The sun shines right through it.

lines.zh: 它咬上叶子，周围就安静了
lines.en: It bites the leaf, and all goes quiet.
It works its way to the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 它的足重新勾住了叶面
lines.en: Its feet catch the leaf again.

lines.zh: 身体被烫得抽搐，蜷得更紧
lines.en: Heat convulses it and it curls tighter.
It hits hard ground and bounces.
Soaked through, its writhing slows.
The blast sends it tumbling over and over.

lines.zh: 箭把叶子和它一起穿住
lines.en: An arrow pins leaf and larva together.
Odd force sets its segments jerking.
Off the leaf, it goes limp as string.
Lightning curls it into a dead knot.
The void draws it off; its feet still hook on.
